title: Nostec
tagline: Privacy-first social network: Nostr + Aztec ZK proofs keep your followers private.
description:
Nostec combines Nostr's decentralized social protocol with Aztec's zero-knowledge
  technology to create a privacy-first social network. Unlike traditional platforms where
  followers and connections are public, Nostec stores follower relationships as encrypted
  notes on Aztec's L2, making your social graph completely private.  ENS is used to link Nostr accounts to Aztec addresses.  Users verify their identity through zkPassport without revealing personal information, and can selectively encrypt posts to specific follower sets. Built with Aztec Noir smart contracts and integrated with ENS for human-readable addresses.
how_its_made:
Nostec is built on Aztec's L2 using Noir smart contracts that store follower relationships
  as private sets of encrypted notes, making social connections invisible except to involved
  parties. Aztec's zero-knowledge proofs cryptographically guarantee social graph privacy.

  The frontend integrates Obsidion wallet for Aztec interactions, ENS to link Nostr accounts
  to Aztec addresses, and Supabase for off-chain indexing. We integrated zkPassport for
  identity verification, though proofs aren't actually verified on Aztec.  And we built a "hacky
   subscribe" button bypassing verification to quickly demonstrate UX.
